name: Is laminate flooring more prone to water damage than other types of flooring?

mainEntity.name: Is laminate flooring more prone to water damage than other types of flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Laminate flooring, with its fiberboard core, is generally more susceptible to significant water damage compared to solid hardwood, which can often be refinished after water exposure. Vinyl plank and tile flooring are highly water-resistant or waterproof. While laminate offers durability against wear and tear, its core makes it vulnerable to swelling and delamination when exposed to standing water or high humidity over time. Proper installation and immediate response to spills are key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, laminate flooring's fiberboard core makes it more prone to swelling and delamination from water than solid hardwood, vinyl, or tile.
